reasoning_summary: The old PDF retained exact p-values, confidence intervals, McNemar/Holm and Bonferroni language, bootstrap and standard-error intervals, and a cross-pool z/p comparison. The revised PDF removes all numerical inferential outputs and significance interpretations. Remaining references to intervals, p-values, tests, and inference only explain that the fixed-pool realized-trace target supplies no probability model, that those quantities are omitted, and that they support no conclusion. The title, abstract, results, limitations, and conclusion consistently label the analysis exploratory and descriptive and condition claims on named pools and recorded scorer realizations. Retained accuracies, effects, discordant counts, pooled counts, subgroup contrasts, and accounting values are finite-pool descriptive quantities; displayed effects reproduce from the reported n and b/c values, and the random-order pooled summaries are arithmetically consistent. Source-reported measurements remain independently unverifiable, but that disclosed evidence limitation does not prevent verification of this inferential-language correction.
